Container.Name: Find My Timeline
Container.Overview: Find My Timeline is a self-hosted location-history dashboard for Apple devices available through the Find My service. It polls device locations at configurable intervals, stores the history locally in SQLite and displays routes, timestamps, battery levels and chronological timelines on an interactive map. The Unraid edition includes persistent appdata storage, Docker health monitoring and optional protected Apple re-authentication. This is an unofficial project and the WebUI must not be exposed directly to the internet.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: Apple Find My location history timeline iCloud tracking map GPS responsive dashboard mobile self-hosted
Container.Requires: Requires an Apple ID with two-factor authentication, internet access and persistent Unraid appdata storage. Initial Apple authentication must be completed through the protected WebUI flow or the container console. The WebUI contains sensitive location history and does not provide full access control for the map and APIs. Use only on a trusted local network, through a VPN or behind an authenticated HTTPS reverse proxy.
Container.Changes: Version 0.2.0. Validated on Unraid OS 7.3.2 with the public GHCR image, persistent database and Apple session volumes, WebUI, health check, device polling and Apple two-factor authentication. Improved Community Applications descriptions, setup guidance and configuration help.

Branch.TagDescription: Latest stable image and recommended option for automatic updates

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: Host port used to open the responsive Find My Timeline WebUI. Keep this port limited to your trusted network and do not expose it directly to the internet.

Config.Name: Database
Config.Description: Persistent directory for the SQLite database containing device and location history. Include this directory in protected backups.

Config.Name: Apple Session
Config.Description: Stores reusable Apple session cookies and authentication metadata. Keep this mapping enabled during updates and include it in protected backups.

Config.Name: Apple ID
Config.Description: Email address of the Apple ID whose Find My devices should be recorded. Do not enter the Apple password in this field.

Config.Name: Enable WebUI authentication flow
Config.Description: Set to true to allow Apple re-authentication from the WebUI. Requires a WebUI administrator password and protected network access.

Config.Name: WebUI administrator password
Config.Description: Create a long and unique password for starting Apple authentication from the WebUI. This protects only authentication actions, not the location map or APIs.

Config.Name: Estimated session lifetime
Config.Description: Estimated Apple session lifetime in days used by the status countdown. Apple can invalidate a session earlier.

Config.Name: Authentication flow timeout
Config.Description: Maximum number of seconds allowed between starting Apple authentication and entering the verification code.

Config.Name: Apple ID password
Config.Description: Optional persistent Apple password. Leaving this empty reduces stored secrets and is recommended for most installations.

Config.Name: Minimum polling interval
Config.Description: Minimum number of minutes between Apple location requests. Use a value no greater than the maximum interval.

Config.Name: Maximum polling interval
Config.Description: Maximum number of minutes between Apple location requests. Must be equal to or greater than the minimum interval.

Config.Name: Database path
Config.Description: Database file path inside the container. Change only when using a custom persistent data layout.

Config.Name: Web host
Config.Description: Internal web server binding. Keep 0.0.0.0 when using the standard Unraid bridge network.

Config.Name: Web port
Config.Description: Internal container port for the WebUI. Normally this should remain 5000.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Timezone used for container logs and displayed timestamps, for example Europe/Berlin.
